title: Japan Liquidity Enhancement Auction, remaining maturities 1-5 years (¥700bn anticipated) — the family's widest menu, and the zone where the coupon ordering breaks
source: EST: mof.go.jp English November 2026 auction calendar (policy/jgbs/auction/calendar/2611e.htm), re-fetched direct 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200, 25,189 bytes) for this initial research; its table row reads 'Nov. 20, 2026 | Liquidity Enhancement Auction (remaining maturities of 1-5 years)'. The DATE is MOF's own. The ¥700bn SIZE is anticipated, not announced: the November row carries no announcement href on 2026-09-09 and MOF's note reads 'Each issue amount will be announced about one week prior to each auction date', putting terms ~2026-11-13 — the seven-day lead is confirmed on this zone's own next print, whose announcement (auct20260903e, HTTP 200) is dated September 3 for a September 10 auction. The anticipated size rests on a RECENT and STILL-MOVING ramp, not a long flat run: MOF's own announcement pages print ¥500bn for the first TEN auctions (2024-01-05 → 2025-07-25), ¥600bn once (2025-09-08) and ¥700bn for the last FIVE (2025-11-21 → 2026-09-10). CADENCE IS EVERY ODD MONTH AND UNBROKEN, AND THIS IS THE ONLY BAND MOF NEVER REDEFINED: its consecutive monthly calendars 2401e → 2611e (35 slates, all HTTP 200; 2612e 404s, not yet published) carry a '1-5 years' Liquidity Enhancement row in all 18 odd months and in none of the 17 even ones, with the label unchanged throughout — while the mid zone was relabelled 5-15.5y → 5-11y and the super-long 15.5-39y → 11-39y on the April 2026 slate. Filed `estimate` on three counts, none of them date doubt: the size is anticipated rather than announced, the reopened-issue list does not exist until MOF's own 'Issues Re-opened' page publishes on the day, and market-events-data.ts's confirmed-prefix taxonomy has no slot for a non-US sovereign debt office. Checked 2026-09-09
notes: Proposed 2026-09-09 by the jgb-20y-auction-2026-11-18 initial-research adjacency sweep (proposals/jgb-liquidity-enhancement-1-5y-2026-11-20.from-jgb-20y-auction-2026-11-18.json, read as input and now shadowed by this canonical file); researched 2026-09-09 (docs/research/events/jgb-liquidity-enhancement-1-5y-2026-11-20.md). THE PROPOSAL'S PREMISE — a same-week 'placebo' outside the BoJ purchase buckets — IS CORRECT BUT MINOR; the reason this entry earns its slot is that the 5-11y sibling named this zone as the untested out-of-sample check on the family's headline coupon ordering, and 16 prints say that ordering IS REAL BUT IS A STEP, NOT A GRADIENT. Paper with a coupon at or above 1.0% is overweight its eligible-stock share by +1.170x against the sub-1% menu (t = +3.34, positive in 14 of 16 auctions) — the sibling's direction, confirmed in a zone it never read. But inside the sub-1% menu, which is 80.7% of eligible stock here, coupon orders nothing (quintile overweights 0.67x / 1.14x / 0.96x / 0.88x, non-monotone), and the sector-level ordering the sibling stated INVERTS where this zone can test it: at matched remaining maturity the 5-Year sector (0.296% weighted-average coupon) runs 0.62x against the 10-Year's (0.118%) 1.39x, a paired -0.766x, t = -2.73, with the 5-Year ahead in only 4 of 16 auctions. The mechanism is that Japan's yield path is U-SHAPED, so coupon proxies issue age with OPPOSITE SIGN either side of 2012: float-weighted corr(coupon, age) is +0.681 across the whole menu but -0.492 inside the post-2012 cohort. The vintage split is the stronger variable outright (age >= 12y vs younger: +1.571x, t = +4.24). AND NEITHER IS A LAW AT THE EXTREME: the oldest, highest-coupon paper on the menu — 30Y No.1-5, issued 1999-2000, 2.507% weighted-average coupon — has taken ¥16.5bn in total across 8 auctions and 28 issue-auction rows, 0.37x against the 20-Year's 1.05x at matched maturity. What actually reads is a pre-2012 20-year pocket, and IT IS DECAYING WITH THE SIZE RAMP: the pocket ran +1.626x across the ten ¥500bn auctions and +0.410x across the six at ¥600-700bn (difference of means t = 2.13), the last print (2026-07-16) went NEGATIVE at -0.88x, and issues reopened rose 22.6 → 38.5 as the offering grew (corr with offering r = +0.588, t = +2.72) — a bigger auction reaches deeper into the menu and dilutes any pocket. THE MID ZONE'S 'COVER IS READABLE HERE' CONCLUSION ALSO DOES NOT TRANSFER: gross bids track offering size at this auction (r = +0.649, t = +3.19), the super-long's signature, against the mid zone's insignificant +0.149. Three zones, three size trajectories, three different answers to 'is cover readable' — no cover rule in this family is portable. NO PRICE CHANNEL IS CLAIMED and impact is `low`: no tracked symbol carries yen-rates exposure and no house playbook is rates-keyed. The auction sits two days after jgb-20y-auction-2026-11-18, five before jgb-40y-auction-2026-11-25, and shares its date with japan-cpi-2026-11-20 and opex-2026-11-20 — the only JGB entry on this calendar whose own domestic inflation print lands the same morning. Estimate widens caution only; it licenses no date-keyed action.
